violation_type.title: Meal and Snack Service - Adult Supervision (26 TAC §744.2421(a)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Meal and Snack Service - Adult Supervision
violation_type.typical_finding: Caregivers were not supervising appropriately to stop cross contamination.  Childdren were observed to be grabbing each others food, putting their feet on the table while eating, and the caregivers did not redirect the children.
